title: Joule Sous Vide Session Target Temperature Leaderboard
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=joule:cook target_temp_c=*
| stats sum(target_temp_c) as total_value, avg(target_temp_c) as avg_value by protein_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks protein values by total and average target temperature across Joule sous vide session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `target_temp_c` values for each Joule sous vide session event and review total and average target temperature by protein.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total target temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly which protein shows the biggest target temperature numbers in your Joule sous vide session data.
